notes: Rotondo's Zombie on the engine's bot brain: its hole brick keeps one zombie (the import reads its h settings: name, side, sight, wander, swipe). The port adds what its scripts did: the zombie's paint and face, its arms held out ahead, and a swipe that turns a bot of another side at half health or less into a zombie. Not ported yet: an infected bot's name gaining 'Zombie', and two zombies of different sides marking each other instead of turning.

handles.ZombieHoleBot::onAdd: the bot kind's look (paint by slot and face, from this copy's script) and emote hug, which holds the arms out ahead as playThread(1, ArmReadyBoth) did
handles.ZombieHoleBot::onBotFollow: only reads positions in the original
handles.holeZombieInfect: melee converts_below: the bot turns into one of the zombie's kind (its body, look, side and swipe) with full health
handles.armor::onCollision: melee converts_below: a zombie's swipe on a bot of another side at or under half health turns it
